fieldDefinitions.rowNumberOnPage: Value in the first table column (`No.`) on that **page** (1–10), not a global MMC serial.
fieldDefinitions.practitionerName: Column `Nama of Practitioner` — display name on the register list.
fieldDefinitions.graduatedFrom: Column `Graduated From` — institution string as shown on the list.
fieldDefinitions.mmcDoctorId: Numeric id from the list row’s `viewDoctor/{id}/search` link (MeRITS internal id; used for the detail endpoint).
fieldDefinitions.detailAbsoluteUrl: Absolute URL to `viewDoctor/{id}/search` (same path the site loads via AJAX for the Details button).
fieldDefinitions.listPage: 1-based result list page this row was scraped from.
fieldDefinitions.globalRowIndex: 1-based index across the crawl: `(listPage - 1) * rowsFirstPage + rowNumberOnPage`, where `rowsFirstPage` is the number of rows parsed on page 1 (used as the page size for this index).

notes: MeRITS registered **doctor** list (MMC), not the NSR specialist register.
Each row is one list entry as shown in search results; use mmcDoctorId / detailAbsoluteUrl if you later scrape the AJAX detail view (not implemented here).
globalRowIndex assumes every page before the last has the same row count as page 1; if the last page is partial, total unique rows equals all.length after a full run.
